name: Austin Desenberg, CMA
headline: Founder of Waterloo Cloud Accounting
about: Enthusiastic NetSuite accountant with a proven history of success through the implementation and management of effective and timely accounting procedures. Experienced in forecasting, internal and external financial reporting, budgeting, HR/Payroll, and operations in the small business landscape. Possesses excellent analytical skills, adherence to deadlines, work ethic, and desire to succeed.

experiences.description:
Founder of Waterloo Cloud Accounting. We perform a mixture of NetSuite and Fractional CFO work for our clients. We leverage our knowledge of accounting and NetSuite to create efficient and reliable financial and accounting solutions. 

https://www.waterloocloudaccounting.com/

• Performing NetSuite Implementations from end to end. Engaged in planning, csv uploads/templates, training, UAT, setting up third party integrations, and post live support.
• Fill in administration and NetSuite support. Auditing client's NetSuite instances.
• Providing suggestions of best practice and opportunities to use both out of the box features and customizations to meet client business workflows.
• Consulted and implemented the following modules: Record to Report, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Design to Build, ARM, Quality Management, Call to Resolution, and Manufacturing.
• Creating workflows to match client business processes and streamline system.
• Working knowledge of SuiteScripts and SuiteCommerce
• Worked with iPasS vendors, including Celigo, to connect to Shopify, Amazon, Magento, BigCommerce, and Salesforce.

• Generated financial and cashflow forecasts, ad hoc reports to enhance financial decisions, budgets/variances, cost benefit analysis, financial models, lease or buy decisions, and profitability analysis. 
• Managed accounting operations including A/P, A/R, general ledger, payment disbursement, internal controls, IRS filings, risk management, data/document retention etc. 
• Prepared timely and accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
• Worked with external CPA and in-house council to setup proper entity structure and prepare tax returns, including 1120, 1120-S, 1065, and owners 1040s.
• Created, in conjunction with the owners, a continuing business plan that focused on managed and continued business growth, business forecasts, KPIs, relationship building, and sales strategy. Company revenue growth increased 269% from 2015 to 2019. 
• Continued focus on efficiency. Refined accounting processes to streamline data across company systems, creating reliable and timely accounting data.
• Partnered with a PEO (Paychex) to setup a dynamic healthcare, 401(k) and payroll system. Responsible for implementation, oversight of employee onboarding, semi-monthly payroll, HR compliance, and workplace employment policies. 
• Collaborated with different department heads to amplify organizational procedures. 
• Maintained communication and built relationships with vendors, bankers, clients, and other business partners.

• A/P and A/R duties, including data entry, check disbursement, document retention, receive payments, and sending invoices to customers. 
• Prepared reconciliations of credit card, bank accounts, and intercompany loan balances.
